ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a circle with Z as the center. W is on the left side of the circle, U is on the right side of the circle, and segment WU passes through the center Z and is a horizontal diameter. V is above and to the left of the circle, Y is below and to the right of the circle, and segment VY passes through the center Z and is a slanted diameter. X is on the circumference at the lower left, located on the arc between W and Y, and in the figure Z is connected respectively to W, X, Y, U, V. Reasoning: Because VY is a diameter, the sum of the central angles corresponding to the semicircle from V to U to Y is 180°, that is, m∠VZU + m∠UZY = 180. Substituting the information given in the problem gives 4x + (2x + 24) = 180, so 6x + 24 = 180, x = 26. Therefore m∠UZY = 2x + 24 = 2(26) + 24 = 76°. Also because WU is a diameter, the sum of the central angles corresponding to the lower semicircle from W to X to Y to U is 180°. The problem gives ∠WZX ≅ ∠XZY; let m∠WZX = m∠XZY = a, then a + a + 76 = 180, so 2a = 104, a = 52. The measure of arc WX equals the measure of the corresponding central angle ∠WZX, therefore m arc WX = 52°.

In $\odot Z$, $\angle WZX \cong \angle XZY$, $m\angle VZU = 4x$, $m\angle UZY = 2x+24$, and $\overline{VY}$ and $\overline{WU}$ are diameters.
Find $m\widehat{WX}$.

method.method_draft: First read the diagram as a circle centered at Z, with W and U endpoints of a horizontal diameter, V and Y endpoints of a slanted diameter, and X on the lower-left arc between W and Y. From the text, use that VY is a diameter, so the central angles on the right semicircle from V to U to Y satisfy m∠VZU + m∠UZY = 180. Thus 4x + (2x + 24) = 180, giving x = 26 and m∠UZY = 76. Next use that WU is a diameter, so the lower semicircle from W to X to Y to U has total central angle 180. Let m∠WZX = m∠XZY = a, using the given congruence. Then a + a + 76 = 180, so a = 52. Since m arc WX equals its central angle m∠WZX, m arc WX = 52.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是以 Z 为圆心的圆。W 在圆的左侧，U 在圆的右侧，线段 WU 经过圆心 Z，是水平直径。V 在圆的上方偏左，Y 在圆的下方偏右，线段 VY 经过圆心 Z，是一条斜直径。X 在左下方圆周上，位于 W 和 Y 之间的弧上，并且图中从 Z 分别连到 W、X、Y、U、V。
推理：因为 VY 是直径，所以从 V 到 U 再到 Y 的半圆对应的中心角和为 180°，即 m∠VZU + m∠UZY = 180。代入题给信息得 4x + (2x + 24) = 180，所以 6x + 24 = 180，x = 26。因此 m∠UZY = 2x + 24 = 2(26) + 24 = 76°。又因为 WU 是直径，所以从 W 到 X 到 Y 到 U 的下半圆对应的中心角和为 180°。题给 ∠WZX ≅ ∠XZY，设 m∠WZX = m∠XZY = a，则 a + a + 76 = 180，所以 2a = 104，a = 52。弧 WX 的度数等于对应中心角 ∠WZX 的度数，因此 m弧WX = 52°。
